newsitem.title: USA: NORWOOD PRES/COO RESIGNS, MERGER TALK ENDS.
newsitem.headline: NORWOOD PRES/COO RESIGNS, MERGER TALK ENDS.

text.p: Norwood Promotional Products Inc said Thursday that its president and chief operating officer, Robert Whitesell, has resigned, effective immediately, and that it was calling off its merger talks with Rou Bill Group.
The company also said it has named James Gunning as chief financial officer.

The company said Whitesell was leaving to pursue other opportunities and will be succeeded by Frank Krasovec, chairman and chief executive officer, who will assume the title of president and all of Whitesell's responsibilities.

Gunning, formerly treasury director of Norwood Promotional Products, has been named chief financial officer effective immediately, said the company. He succeeds Max Waits, who will serve as a vice-president.

In addition, the company said it has ended all negotiations relating to the acquisition of Rou Bill Group, and that it will disclose its intentions about its troubled Alpha Division in the near future.
Norwood supplies promotional products to more than 11,100 distributors, in both domestic and international markets.
